name: dm-interactive-table
description: Interactive digital table for D&D campaigns with DM control panel, real-time map sync, and AI-assisted storytelling.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.test:smoke: npm run prisma:generate --prefix server && node scripts/smoke-test.js
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint --prefix client && npm run docs:validate && npm run test:vision && npm run test:camera && npm run test:layers && npm run test:security && npm run test:recovery && npm run test:workflow && npm run prisma:validate --prefix server && npm run test:smoke
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server

author: Joel Martinez
